source.editorialClaim: DSH STORE provides page layout and does not label the article as DSH STORE original

gates: origin/main must still equal the bound base Commit before push
every scoped precondition and expected SHA-256 must match
all three original-publication links and Article isBasedOn must equal the user-supplied WeChat URL
international and domestic builds must both include the article in About, Sitemap, and release manifest
international canonical must use dsh.store and domestic canonical must use dsh-store.cn
both article builds must publish en, zh-CN, and x-default hreflang mappings plus the opposite-site switch
desktop and 390-pixel mobile visual checks must have no page-level horizontal overflow
required pull-request checks must pass before protected-main merge
both GitHub Pages release manifests must report the merged main Commit and contain the article file
refresh international and domestic services serially, never in parallel
both public article routes and About links must pass visible and source readback

rollback.repository: revert the merged pull request through a new auditable pull request
rollback.pages: retain the last successful Pages artifact until a verified replacement is available
rollback.servers: each refresh service must preserve its existing release/current symlink on failure and use its atomic rollback path
rollback.trigger: any failed deterministic gate, manifest mismatch, serial refresh failure, public readback mismatch, or wrong original-publication URL
